# Zevio

> Zevio is a multi-tenant SaaS that turns WhatsApp into a booking engine for service businesses. AI handles customer conversations while teams run operations from a modern dashboard.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, features, and how Zevio automates WhatsApp bookings.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How Zevio collects, uses, and protects information.
- [Terms of Service](/terms): Terms governing the use of the Zevio platform.
